 Oppo’s Reno 17 series and Xiaomi’s 18 Pro lineup headline the week, while more flagships line up for India later this month
 by Sagnik Das Gupta Published: 15 November 2026, 07:30 IST Add as preferred source Share Image Credit: Oppo
 Summary
 The Oppo Reno 17 and Reno 17 Pro will launch in China on November 16, 2026.
 Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max will launch globally on November 17, 2026.
 The Vivo X500 series and Motorola Signature 27 are expected to launch in India later this month.
 The third week of November is all about flagships. Oppo kicks things off with the Reno 17 series in China and Xiaomi follows a day later with the global debut of its Xiaomi 18 Pro lineup. Both launches could also tell us what to expect when these phones eventually reach India.
 Upcoming Phones Launching This Week
 Here’s a quick look at all the upcoming phones launching in the third week of November 2026:
 Phone Launch Date 
 Oppo Reno 17 and Reno 17 Pro November 16, 2026 
 Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max November 17, 2026 
 Related Articles
 Xiaomi Hikes Redmi Phone Prices in India by up to Rs 4,000 – Check New Prices Sagnik Das Gupta Less than an hour ago Oppo Reno 17 and Reno 17 Pro
 The Oppo Reno 17 series will launch in China on November 16, 2026, at 7:00 PM local time (or 4:30 PM IST ). The lineup includes the standard Oppo Reno 17 and the Oppo Reno 17 Pro, and both phones are already up for pre-order in China. 
 Oppo will also unveil the Oppo Pad Air 6 and Oppo Watch 5 at the same event. The design has already been revealed, and the camera module looks largely unchanged from the Oppo Reno 16 . 
 The highlight is the Oppo Reno 17’s glowing cat design on the Adventure Cat variant, which lights up under blue light. Oppo has also confirmed the other colour options: Cocoa Brown, First Snow White and Ice Moon White.
 Image Credit: Oppo Image Credit: Oppo Oppo has also confirmed the chipsets for the Reno 17 and Reno 17 Pro ahead of the launch, and a recent Oppo Reno 17 series full specs leak has filled in the rest. 
 The standard Reno 17 is tipped to feature a 6.56-inch 1.5K flat display and a massive 8,000mAh battery with 80W charging, powered by the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset .
 Interestingly, the Oppo Reno 17 Pro is the more compact of the two. It could get a 6.32-inch 1.5K flat display, a 7,200mAh battery with 80W charging and the more powerful Dimensity 8550 Super chipset. 
 Both Oppo phones are also said to feature a metal frame and an optical in-display fingerprint sensor. 
 For cameras, both phones are expected to pack a 200 MP main camera, a 50 MP ultrawide and a 50 MP periscope telephoto lens. Meanwhile, the Pro is tipped to get a 50 MP selfie camera. 
 They may come with up to 12 GB of RAM and 512 GB of storage, and ship with ColorOS 17 based on Android 17 out of the box.
 As for India, Oppo hasn’t confirmed anything yet. The standard Reno 17 is expected to arrive in early 2027, possibly alongside a Reno 17c, but the Oppo Reno 17 Pro may not launch in India at all.
 Related Articles
 Oppo Pad Air 6 Debuts with 2.8K Display and Dimensity 7360 Super Abubakar Mohammed 2 hours ago Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
 Next up, the Xiaomi 18 Pro series global launch is set for November 17, 2026, in Paris at 2:00 PM local time (or 6:30 PM IST ). 
 Xiaomi will unveil the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max about two months after their China debut. Both phones will be available in Velvet Red, Cosmic Blue and White globally.
 The standout feature of both phones is the rear display, which sits next to the cameras on the back. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max runs on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 , while the 18 Pro could stick with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 . 
 Both Xiaomi phones feature LTPO OLED panels on the front and back, along with a 200 MP main camera, a 200 MP periscope telephoto and a 50 MP ultrawide.
 However, global buyers may get smaller batteries than in China. An early retail listing (via AndroidTreasure ) suggests the global Xiaomi 18 Pro will pack a 6,000mAh battery with 90W charging, while the 18 Pro Max could drop from 8,500mAh to 7,050mAh, though it will retain 100W charging.
 The Xiaomi 18 Pro India launch is already confirmed, but it will most likely get a separate India event after the global debut. The Pro Max hasn’t been confirmed for India yet.
 If you ask me, I also do hope that the Xiaomi 18 Pro Transparent Edition makes it to India, as I recently went hands-on with it and it's an absolute stunner!

 Oppo Watch 5 Launched With 1.85-inch AMOLED Display, 4 GB Storage and 7 Day Battery Life Shashwat Khatri 2 hours ago Other Upcoming Phones in November 2026
 That said, beyond this week, the rest of November is shaping up to be busy in India. 
 The Vivo X500 series India launch is set for November 26, and it will include the Vivo X500 , Vivo X500 Pro and Vivo X500 Pro Max . Vivo will also launch the Watch GT2 smartwatch, along with a Photographer Kit for the Pro Max.
 Image Credit: X/ @Vivo India Image Credit: X/ @Vivo India The Motorola Signature 27 India launch is also set for this month, according to Motorola India’s microsite. Motorola still hasn’t announced an exact date, but with only two weeks of November left, we expect it any day now.
 On the budget end, the Wobble Speed 5G India launch is expected soon, especially now that Wobble has signed Suryakumar Yadav as its brand ambassador . 
 Meanwhile, the iQOO 16 India launch is expected in mid-December, so fans will have to wait a little longer.
